4.7.heading: Template Header Media Limits
4.7.subheading: Meta file format specifications, upload size constraints, and recommended resolutions for template headers:

items.title: Image Header
items.description:
Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP. Maximum file size: ≤ 5 MB.
Recommended dimensions: ~800 × 418 px (1.91:1 ratio). Ideal for campaign banners, discounts, and product promos.

items.title: Video Header
items.description:
Supported format: MP4 container with H.264 video and AAC audio encoding.
Maximum file size: ≤ 16 MB. Maximum duration: ≤ 60 seconds. First frame auto-renders as recipient thumbnail.

items.title: Document Header
items.description:
Supported format: PDF document format with full multi-page support.
Maximum file size: ≤ 100 MB. Ideal for sending invoices, price quotes, contracts, and downloadable product brochures.

4.7.tip_note: Meta reviews template header media during submission. For dynamic broadcasts, you can override the media URL per recipient.

5.heading: Meta WhatsApp Costs - When You Pay and When You Do Not

banner.label: *Disclaimer:**
banner.text: Meta changes pricing by country and over time. Always check the official page:
banner.note: Below is a practical guide for planning, not a legal quote.

cards.title: Service Window (Free / Low)
cards.description: Replies within the 24-hour customer window are service conversations with lowest cost or free tiers.

cards.title: Business Initiated (Paid)
cards.description: Starting a chat or messaging outside 24 hours requires an approved template and incurs Meta fees.

cards.title: Category Billing Rates
cards.description: Marketing has the highest rate, Utility has medium, and Authentication has the lowest rate.

5.1.heading: You are generally NOT charged when:
5.1.subheading: Understanding non-billable customer care windows, service messages, and internal CRM activities:

items.title: Reply Inside 24-Hour Window
items.description: You reply inside the 24-hour customer window after they messaged you (service conversation).

items.title: Customer Opens Service Window
items.description: The customer initiates contact and opens a service window, and you respond with free text replies.

items.title: Meta Free Tier Allowance
items.description: Meta provides monthly free tier service conversations (country-specific allowances apply).

items.title: Message Delivery Failures
items.description: A message fails to deliver to the recipient (undelivered template attempts are not billed).

items.title: Draft Broadcast Campaigns
items.description: You save, edit, and configure draft broadcasts in waCRM without actually launching or sending them.

items.title: Non-Messaging waCRM Features
items.description: You manage sales pipelines, assign tags, update custom fields, and write internal notes.

5.1.tip_note: waCRM Tip: Inbound customer conversations automatically reset the 24-hour service window timer.

5.2.heading: You ARE charged (Meta conversation fee) when:
5.2.subheading: Understanding Meta conversation charges, billable events, and template fees:

items.title: Approved Template Start / Re-open
items.description: You send an approved template to start a new chat or re-open a business-initiated conversation.

items.title: Broadcast Campaigns
items.description: You send a broadcast campaign using a Marketing or Utility template to opted-in contacts.

items.title: Template Category Rates
items.description: The category assigned dictates billing (Marketing costs more than Utility in most regions).

items.title: Messaging Outside 24h Window
items.description: You message a user outside the 24-hour window, requiring a paid template conversation.

5.2.tip_note: waCRM Tip: Meta conversation charges cover unlimited messages within that 24-hour category window.

5.3.heading: How Category Changes the Cost
5.3.subheading: Illustrative baseline rates for planning (check Meta's calculator for live country pricing):

rows.action: Send "Request Demo for HRMS" promo template
Send "Your demo is confirmed for tomorrow 3 PM"
Customer asks "What is the price?" and you reply within 24h

5.3.tip_note: One broadcast to 1,000 people ~ up to 1,000 billable conversations if each opens a new 24h window. Meta charges per window, not per waCRM message.

5.4.heading: What waCRM Shows Instead of Dollar Costs
5.4.subheading: In Broadcasts -> Step 4, waCRM tracks operational safety metrics, recipient quotas, and Meta account health:

items.title: Estimated Recipients
items.description: Calculates reachable contact counts after applying customer opt-in verification and audience tag filters.

items.title: Messaging Limit Tier
items.description: Displays your active daily recipient allowance: 250, 1K, 10K, or 100K unique customer conversations per 24 hours.

items.title: Account Quality Rating
items.description: Monitors real-time Meta phone number health status (Green High / Yellow Medium / Red Low) based on recipient feedback.

items.title: Compliance & Tier Warnings
items.description: Flags pre-send warnings if your selected audience exceeds your daily tier quota or includes unverified contacts.

5.4.tip_note: waCRM Tip: High quality ratings enable Meta to automatically increase your messaging tier from 1K up to 100K recipients per day.

5.5.heading: Opt-in and Compliance (Avoids Wasted Sends)
5.5.subheading: Protect sender reputation, maintain high Meta quality ratings, and avoid costly wasted broadcast spend:

items.title: Enable "Only Opted-in Contacts"
items.description:
Activate in Broadcasts Step 2 to strictly restrict broadcasts to contacts with verified consent.
Eliminates wasted messaging spend and prevents user spam complaints before sending.

items.title: Contact opt_in_at Timestamp
items.description:
Contacts require an opt_in_at timestamp recorded in waCRM to qualify for broadcasts.
Populated automatically via inbound webhooks, opt-in forms, CSV imports, or manual updates.

items.title: Prevent Quality Downgrades & Bans
items.description:
Sending to unconsented users triggers spam reports and drops your rating from Green to Red.
While not a direct per-message fine, repeated policy infractions lead Meta to permanently ban your number.

5.5.tip_note: Meta evaluates block and report rates in real time. Maintaining documented customer opt-in protects your business sender reputation.

POS-5.1.heading: Common POS Problems & Solutions
POS-5.1.subheading: Instant Field Remediation Matrix for Cashiers, Waiters & Admins

items.title: Addon Not Showing
items.description: Cause: Addon group unlinked. Solution: Go to Masters -> Dishes -> attach addon group to target dish.

items.title: Confirm Split Is Grey
items.description: Cause: Remaining balance > 0. Solution: Check bottom remaining bar; add tender lines until Remaining is SAR 0.00.

items.title: KOT on Wrong Printer
items.description: Cause: Incorrect station mapping. Solution: Settings -> Printer -> Printer Mapping; reassign departments.

items.title: Stock Not Increasing
items.description: Cause: Only PO raised. Solution: Open Stock Receiving, enter delivered quantities, and confirm receipt.

items.title: Tax Looks Wrong on Bill
items.description: Cause: Tax rate misconfigured. Solution: Admin updates in Settings -> Tax; do not attempt manual tax editing on floor.

items.title: Card Payment Always Fails
items.description: Cause: Bridge disconnected or training mode active. Solution: Verify SoftPOS bridge & turn off simulate mode.

POS-5.1.tip_note: For unresolved technical issues, reach out immediately via your dedicated Isarva Support channel.
